differences.name: Barkly Tableland
differences.reason: A region of cattle country, not a place with a defined thing to see; the region name is for a destination or tag, not a spot. Wikivoyage page is a region.

differences.name: Barrow Creek Hotel
differences.reason: Famous 1926 outback pub with tin ceiling and messages covering the walls; a quirky venue, but a pub and named only by a regional guide site (Discover Central Australia) and ExplorOz, so one weak-counted source.
